A Mission That Begins With Respect.

Helper Hands was started by Nikhil with one simple dream: that no elderly person should spend their last years hungry, unwell and alone.

Many elders in our city have been left behind by their own children. We believe every parent deserves food, medical care, dignity and someone to talk to.

Our initiative focuses on small but meaningful actions, including meals, medicines and health check-ups, clothing and blankets, ration kits and regular visits.

We are starting small, but our intentions are big. We believe real change begins when ordinary people come together to help others.

We don't believe in making big promises. We believe in taking real action, documenting our work and maintaining transparency.

They raised us. Now it is our turn to care for them.

Our Mission

Caring for elderly people abandoned by their families through meals, medicines, clothing, daily essentials and companionship.

Small Contributions. Meaningful Change.

Your support can help turn a simple intention into a real act of kindness.

Whether it is a meal, a medicine, a blanket or a visit, every contribution can help us reach an elder who needs it.

Privacy Policy

We collect personal details only if you choose to contact us or volunteer, and we use them only to reply to you. We do not sell or share your details. This website itself does not store form entries.

We never publish elders' names, addresses, medical or family details, and we publish identifiable photographs only with the person's own consent. To ask us to delete your details, contact us by email.
